citation: Xia Shang Zhou Chronology Project Expert Group (夏商周断代工程专家组). 2000. 夏商周断代工程1996—2000年阶段成果报告：简本 [The Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project Report on the 1996–2000 Provisional Results: Brief Edition]. Beijing: World Publishing Corporation (世界图书出版公司). ISBN 9787506241380 (commonly cited).
notes: Official brief report of the state-sponsored Xia–Shang–Zhou Chronology Project (XSZCP). Widely cited for proposed absolute bands (e.g. conventional Western Zhou start 1046 BCE; Shang start c. 1600 BCE; Xia start c. 2070 BCE in project publicity). HIGHLY CONTESTED in overseas and some Chinese scholarship for method and Xia historicity assumptions. Register as a documented chronological *scheme* — place disputed endpoints and Xia assumptions in Notes; do NOT treat as settled fact-library calendar.
